title: Event catering
intro: Catering options are available for meetings, conferences and celebrations at Toynbee Hall.

blocks.heading: Food and refreshments
paragraphs: The venue team can discuss tea and coffee, snacks, lunches, dinners and beverages to suit the style and schedule of your event.

blocks.heading: Add catering to your booking
paragraphs: Contact events@toynbeehall.org.uk or call 020 7392 2920 to discuss menus and requirements.
